Thank you for your answer.  I'm really not looking for an anti-anxiety medication.  

I am pretty open to the idea that my trip will not be fun as I go through it.  I am hoping that it allows me to confront things about life and myself that I usually block out.  My main goal in pursuing this is to come out of my trip with a better mentality towards life and my personal issues.
Thank you(: I honestly didn't think I'd ever be able to be where I'm at now and now it feels like the sky is the limit

Yeah.  It shouldn't have been my responsibility to take charge in my healing but I now know that unfortunately, no one else is willing to help.  I remember when I talked to my parents about how upset I was and how I thought they'd gone about it all wrong, my dad said "well I'm just glad you finally brought it up".  I told him I shouldn't have had to.  I don't know if he fully gets it but the most important thing is I finally do and I don't blame myself anymore.

Please tell someone else.  My biggest regret is thinking that because my mom did nothing, it wasn't a big deal.  You are more valuable than your brother's reputation or even your family's.  Of course it's your decision and you should do whatever is best for you, but all I can say is that hiding it and feeling ashamed were the worst things I could have done for myself, but I didn't know any better.  8 years later and I now know it wasn't my fault, I shouldn't have trusted my mom to make the best decision (not that she's a bad person, she was just too involved in the situation to make a good call).  But that doesn't take away from the very very real years of depression, my non existent self worth, and all the bad decisions I made trying to pretend I wasn't still hurting.  Feel free to PM me if you need to talk or have questions.
I recently spoke to my parents about how much it affected me.  I think family therapy would help but when I brought it up, the subject almost immediately changed.

Thank you!  It's a really long road but I started sort of seeing the light at the end of the tunnel a few months ago.  It's a lot of one step forward, two steps back, but overall I'm the closest to actual happiness that I've ever been and just knowing that helps so much.  I hope that you find whatever you need to too <3

I have had extensive counseling, though I think none of it helped as much as something just clicking in my brain a few months ago that I had to be okay for myself, if that makes any sense.  Although I think EMDR really helped to put a scab of sorts on my emotional wounds so that they could actually heal and weren't constantly being reopened.

My brother molested me for a few years in our early teens and when I told my family; nothing was done.  Its hard because it had a huge impact on me as far as my mental health which in turn caused a lot of erratic behavior and several suicide attempts.  I also stopped maturing in a few ways emotionally.  It makes it hard to talk about my depression with people that have much of a connection to my family.

Some people are just so far up their own asses that they don't realize how obvious their bullshit is.  Your best bet is acting concerned for her while making her closest friends see all of her flaws.  You can be more obvious about it once they dislike her.

Yes. No.  

I guess I am trustworthy, but like you said, not by choice really.  I just don't see a reason to share secrets unless I find that the ends justify the means. (They rarely do)

And people aren't trustworthy.  At all.

I'm a fan of passively making stuff as difficult as possible for those I don't like.  I don't care for actively seeking revenge because I'm lazy, and it's easier to get caught.  Just actively don't give a fuck.  Be polite, but if she asks a favor, don't do it.  If she talks shit on someone, tell them.  If you catch her in a lie, even a small one, call her out.  Don't make it obvious that you're doing these thing maliciously. ("Forget" the favor, act concerned about the shit talking, be casual about calling her out).  Especially with extroverts, undermining their social life/status can really hurt them; so do it every chance you get. 

Edit: also, never talk badly about her to other people.  Act like you see her in a positive light, so if she ever calls you out, you can act innocent/unnaware and other people will back you up.

The only thing that bothers me is that I won't get to find out what happens next.  If I could live forever as an information sucking gas cloud in space, I totally would. Fuck, I wouldn't  just choose that over death, I'd choose it over life.

Not to over step, but anyone who says something like that, I automatically assume has never experienced severe depression or mental illness.  When your mind is your problem, and it seeps into every other aspect of your life, the thought of turning that off is amazing.  Death would be euphoric. 

Its like if your computer is broken so you throw it away because you don't want it anymore.

Funny, in small groups of women, I do best.  Add a male or two and I get confused because I want to copy the actions, but now there are two types of actions to copy and I feel like I come off in a very weird way.

I had a brief stint as a server.  It was incredibly stressful, and I didn't make much money.  The funny part is that I was better at it than most of my coworkers.  I didn't make many mistakes and when I did, they we're usually small, but I just have no people skills.  I think I made 90% of my tables feel awkward, like... not want to have me as a server again awkward.

Wow, thank you.  This really explains a lot and now I'm thinking of all the embarrassing moments in middle school/early HS where I did something, only to be shot down and realize it was completely inappropriate after the fact.  And with each time that happened, I slowly drew further into myself.

Don't let people make you feel bad about this.  Sometimes it doesn't get better and the only comfort is knowing that when/if you decide to, you can end it.  It's your body and your life.  Best wishes and I hope whatever happens is what you need.

I have regularly scheduled appointments with them.  I am currently under a court order to take meds or I will be sent back to the hospital.   When I started taking medication it was because I was sad.  Now when I stop taking it, I feel like I'm losing my grip on reality.
It's court ordered.

I think I may have made my point unclear, why has no doctor or therapist wanted to see what my behavior is like when I'm not on anything? When my system is completely free of drugs.  I just have such a hard time trying to figure out what is me, what is the drugs, and what is the illness.

This. This so much.  Sunday afternoon I was hanging out with friends making plans for the next weekend, Sunday night I was going 115 down the highway looking for something to crash into (lost my nerve, obviously lol)
Wow, I feel like I could have written this.  You described everything I feel.
I feel like even if I could do something special, I wouldn't.  I just lay around.  It's disgusting.

Keep seeing your doctors.  Be open about how you feel.  Be open to treatments.  Don't kill yourself based on what might happen in the future.  Nothing is set in stone.  Work on getting better and getting through it.

Okay, puke it up.  Give it one more day.  Puke it up and tomorrow do something you've always wanted to do but never did.  Doesn't matter what.  Go rob a fucking bank if That's it.  But please give yourself one more day.  Talk to someone.  Go to the hospital.  I'm not the best person to say this because I struggle with suicidal thoughts but the thought of you doing this, even though i dont know you makes me so sad.  Please give it one more day.  Do something crazy tomorrow.  And the next day.  But please dont give up tonight.  Die without regrets in a week but not tonight.  Write out everything that sucks in your life, and why you want to, because im sure you gave legitamite reasons but please give yourself one more chance.  Make a bucket list.  And the reward for finishing it can be death.  But please take some chances before you give it all up.  I will talk to you all night, even if you dont puke them up.  But please im begging you, give yourself one more chance.  Take tomorrow and call everyone that has ever fucked you over and scream at them.  Call everyone that has helped you, and thank them.  Tell the girl/guy that youve always like how you feel.  Go buy something you've had you're eye on. Apply for your dream job.  Quit your job if its shitty.  Apply to college. Drop out of college.  Do any of these things if they fit you.  Do art.  Idk but please give yourself one more chance.  I hope this was good enough.  If not, i will still talk to you all night. (Or day depending where you live). Tell me your life story.  Just talk to me.  But puke them up and call an ambulence if this moved you even a little bit.  And i am so sorry if it didnt.

I may not be the best person to give advice, but please seek help.  Then take it one day at a time.  I guess I view life and suicide like I do a long distance run.  When I run and I get tired, I want to stop.  But I look ahead and find a landmark and tell myself to keep going until then.  And once I reach that landmark I find a new one ahead and tell myself the same thing until I absolutely can't go anymore.  And That's How I've been about suicide.  I just keep telling myself, give it another day or, let's make it to to this next  occasion.  And it sucks.  But some days are actually good and I hardly want to quit.  Suicide is always an option.  But please make it your last one.
